items.question: Which scripture is declared the crown of the Lord among the listed traditions?
premises: Kamika and related texts are Shiva-knowledge.
Shiva-knowledge is the crown of the Lord.
The Lord's crown is always so.
items.inference: Therefore Kamika and related Shiva-knowledge is the Lord's eternal crown.
uncertainties: Exact verse syntax beyond the supplied tokens is not available.
items.plain_english: The Kamika and other Shiva-knowledges are always the crown of the Lord.
